label: A different actual CONCRETE_6 being that one depends on for its being is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1 to it
paraphrase: At the selected world w, for any c and x, if c is distinct from x, both are concrete and exist at w, and x depends for its being on c (DEF-DEPENDS-FOR-BEING), then c is simply prior to x (SIMPLY_PRIOR_1). The actual-concrete, distinct-relata counterpart of STMT-NONMUTUAL-DEPENDENCE-SUFFICES-FOR-PRIORITY: it needs no nonmutuality antecedent and no possible-separation premise, and it says nothing of D(x,x), of non-actual or non-concrete relata, or of whole-existence priority beyond the primitive SIMPLY_PRIOR_1. It does not give the unscoped premise. Derived, not assumed, by composing the distinct-relata dependence-to-grounding bridge with STMT-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-IS-SIMPLE-PRIORITY.
